latest.headline: The Fire Alarm Has Been Turned Off. The Fire Has Not Gone Out.
latest.summary: SPY advanced in an overbought condition while the captured tape showed every green SPY candle in the observed sequence accompanied by a green VIX candle, SPY pushing through three successive divergent Bollinger-band points, the 30-year Treasury still above 5.2%, and Brent and WTI remaining elevated. The warning cluster appeared, but downside expression was muted as yield-linked algorithmic buying persisted and VIX rolled lower. THE ALARM IS STILL OFF.
